summary: Integrated Media Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K correcting the date of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) from June 5 to June 9, 2026. The filing is a routine administrative correction to a meeting notice and explanatory memorandum of an Australian company, equivalent to a proxy statement amendment in the US. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is indicated. The filing does not contain any deal terms, pricing, board recommendations, or structural events. It is a standard corporate governance update with no event-driven catalyst.
